title: 2021 LSOA to 2021 MSOA (England and Wales)
description: Official ONS exact-fit lookup from 2021 Output Areas to Lower and Middle Layer Super Output Areas, December 2021, stored at LSOA level: every 2021 LSOA lies wholly in one 2021 MSOA.

files.note: Exported from the ONS Open Geography Portal feature service as the 35672 distinct rows of LSOA21CD, LSOA21NM, LSOA21NMW, MSOA21CD, MSOA21NM, MSOA21NMW, ordered by LSOA21CD. The finer rows the service publishes are not stored.
